title: My Events
subtitle: Everything you're working on. Filter by status, search by title, or open one to manage it.

empty.title: No events yet
empty.body: Start your first event — Deer Planner fills the rest.

noMatches.title: No matching events
noMatches.body: Try a different filter or search term.

card.draftMessage: Complete the invitation modules and select a template before publishing.

new.title: Start a new event
new.subtitle: Choose a type, give it a working title, and pick the date. You can refine everything else after.

fields.title: Event title
fields.titlePlaceholder: e.g. María & Juan's wedding, Sofía turns 30…

preview.label: By the time your guests see this:

errors.title: A title is required
errors.date: Choose a date for the event
errors.future: The event date must be in the future

edit.title: Edit event
edit.subtitle: Update the basics. You can drill into the more specific details (locations, story, contacts, RSVP) from the event detail tabs.

overview.title: Overview
overview.dataEmpty: Nothing captured yet. Use the tabs to fill in locations, program, contacts, and more.
overview.invitationInactive: The invitation hasn't been activated yet. Pick a template and turn it on.
overview.dangerZoneHelp: Archiving hides the event from your active list. Unarchiving moves it back to draft so you can keep editing. Permanent deletion removes every trace, including guests and RSVPs.

warnings.archiveConfirm: Archive this event? We'll hide it from your active list — you can unarchive it later.
warnings.restoreConfirm: Unarchive this event? It will move back to draft so you can keep editing.

weddings.title: Wedding data
weddings.subtitle: Wedding-specific fields that fill the invitation template. Couples, story, dress code, gift registry, parents, accommodation.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Where is each part of the event happening? Ceremony, reception, after-party, hotel block…
locations.empty: No locations yet. Add at least the ceremony venue.

program.title: Program
program.subtitle: The day-of schedule. Shown verbatim on the invitation.
program.empty: No program yet — guests will see only the start time on the invitation.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.subtitle: Who should guests call when they have questions?

countdown.ariaLabel: {{days}} days, {{hours}} hours, {{minutes}} minutes and {{seconds}} seconds remaining

statuses.title: Status
statuses.draftDescription: The invitation is not yet published. Only you can see it.
statuses.publishedDescription: The invitation is live. Guests can read it and RSVP.
statuses.archivedDescription: The event is archived. Move it back to draft to keep working on it.
